title: Edge etch
description: A stacked ceramic silhouette resolves into crisp extracted edges on ultramarine.
useCase: Turn local brightness changes into a tunable line-art treatment.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Nine procedural luminance samples per pixel; no imported photograph or semantic object tracing.
look: Saturated ultramarine field with a centred stack of four pebble-like ellipses drawn as thin white outlines, flat with no fill or shading.
motion: The stacked silhouette rocks up to 7° each way on a slow 29-second sine while a Sobel pass extracts its edges; the sensitivity slider moves the edge threshold.
adapt: The Sobel kernel in the `FRAGMENT` shader's `main` samples `field`, a procedural stack of four ellipses swayed by `rot`; tune `threshold` and `bg`, or replace `field` with your own luminance source. Keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
